# Configuration Schema Documentation

This document describes the structure and data types of the server configuration file.

## Top-Level Keys

| Key Name | Data Type | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| port | number | The network port on which the server will listen for incoming connections |
| host | string | The host IP address that the server binds to (0.0.0.0 means all available interfaces) |
| document_root | string | The root directory path from which the server serves files |
| index_file | string | The default HTML file to serve when accessing the root path |

## Summary

The configuration file contains 4 top-level keys, all of which are primitive data types (number or string). There are no nested objects or arrays in this configuration structure.
